chapter_title: A Catechumen asked the Apostle: When I would give an Offering to the Saints, shall I inflict a Wound on the Alms?
chapter_note: This chapter is dominated by institutional/pastoral concerns (catechumen alms for the elect; anxiety about harming the living soul in food-preparation) presented in a dialogue frame. The central content is an ethical/therapeutic analogy (enemy/judge vs doctor) used to reassure and exhort catechumens; it does not expound the impersonal, systematic cosmos→cosmos correspondential architecture characteristic of the oldest substrate. No recoverable core teaching layer can be cleanly extracted here.
